```{=html}
<div class="proof-lab" data-proof-lab="myhill-nerode"></div>
<noscript>
  <h1>Myhill–Nerode theorem</h1>
  <p>A DFA induces a finite compatible right-invariant relation. Every such relation refines the relation of identical future behavior. If that canonical relation has finite index, its equivalence classes form a quotient DFA recognizing the language.</p>
</noscript>
```
